summary: Bound client message-send confirmation waits and reserve one automatic heal replay at a time

replay.detail: No new replay trigger. Existing heal replay and its graph/health commit remain; an in-progress reservation prevents simultaneous callers queueing duplicate full rebuilds. One admitted replay is still unbounded.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, admission, retention or drop-rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Client-v0 message.send may return HTTP503 message-send-unconfirmed with retryable:false and applied:unknown, action_id and idempotency_key. Existing safe unknown-code handling preserves the message; clients must retain the identical request/key. At the pending-worker limit it returns existing rate-limited before submission. No schema/client generator shape changes.

downtime.detail: Standard daemon restart only; no additional measured downtime claim.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion. An unconfirmed send must be retried with its original request/key, not treated as rejected.

recovery.detail: Queued sends may still complete after confirmation timeout. Existing deterministic message identity, action gate and durable action receipt retain same-key dedupe; this does not certify binary downgrade or cure full-replay cost.
